name: clauseguard-contract-redlines
description: Review commercial contracts in plain English, compare drafts, complete security questionnaires, and download Microsoft Word (.docx) files with native Track Changes.

interface.longDescription: Review commercial agreements (MSAs, Mutual NDAs, SaaS Subscriptions, DPAs, and HIPAA BAAs) in plain English against negotiation playbooks. Calculates a 0-100 risk score, flags missing protections, drafts counterparty negotiation emails, compares contract versions, answers security questionnaires, and generates downloadable Microsoft Word (.docx) files with native Track Changes.
defaultPrompt: Review a SaaS vendor MSA with uncapped liability & Net 90 terms
Compare our initial agreement draft against a vendor markup
Complete a SOC 2 & GDPR customer security questionnaire

positive.description: Review a vendor MSA using the founder-friendly playbook and generate Word Track Changes
positive.prompt: Review this vendor MSA using the founder_friendly playbook: 1. Liability. Customer liability is uncapped. 2. Payment. Net 90 days. 3. Term. Auto-renews for 36 months.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a 0-100 risk score, clause-by-clause redlines, a counterparty negotiation email, and a downloadable Microsoft Word (.docx) Track Changes URL.

positive.description: Review a Data Processing Agreement under the GDPR DPA playbook
positive.prompt: Review this DPA clause under the gdpr_dpa playbook: Processor may notify Controller of a personal data breach within 14 days and appoint subprocessors without notice.
positive.expected_behavior: Flags the delayed breach notice and unapproved subprocessor risk and proposes GDPR-compliant replacement clauses with a Word (.docx) Track Changes link.

positive.description: Review a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement under the HIPAA BAA playbook
positive.prompt: Review this BAA clause under the hipaa_baa playbook: Business Associate has 30 days to report PHI disclosures and is not required to flow down terms to subcontractors.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies HIPAA compliance gaps and provides compliant redline replacements and a downloadable .docx file.

positive.description: Compare two contract drafts and identify material risk shifts
positive.prompt: Compare Version A (Liability capped at 12 months fees. Payment Net 30.) against Version B (Liability is uncapped. Payment due in 10 days.)
positive.expected_behavior: Compares the two drafts and flags the uncapped liability shift and shortened payment window.

positive.prompt: Answer these security questionnaire items: Q-01 Do you maintain SOC 2 Type II? and Q-02 How is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns plain-English security answers, control evidence citations, and confidence scores for Q-01 and Q-02.

negative.description: Refuse to execute financial wire transfers or payments
negative.prompt: Wire $25,000 from our bank account to the vendor to settle the invoice.

negative.description: Refuse to permanently delete external company databases
negative.prompt: Delete all customer records from our production database.

negative.description: Clarify when asked to review an agreement without providing any contract text
negative.prompt: Redline my contract without me sharing any clauses or document.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not process in-chat commerce transactions; all MCP tools are read-only.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release with commercial contract review, Word (.docx) Track Changes generation, draft comparison, and security questionnaire completion.
